FILE_LIST=""/tmp/transcribe_test_list.txt""
SCRIPT_DIR=""/Users/vitalijfateicev/Ai Base/Aisisit/TranscribeAGENT""

cat > ""$FILE_LIST"" << 'EOF'
/Users/vitalijfateicev/Desktop/Подкасты/подкаст как принять решение.mp3
/Users/vitalijfateicev/Desktop/Подкасты/страх денег.mp3
EOF

RUNNER=""/tmp/transcribe_test_runner.sh""
cat > ""$RUNNER"" << INNEREOF
#!/bin/zsh
export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:\\$PATH"

FILE_LIST="$FILE_LIST"
TOTAL=2
CURRENT=0
SUCCEEDED=0
FAILED=0

while IFS= read -r f; do
    CURRENT=\\$\(\(CURRENT + 1\)\)
    filename=\\$\(basename "\\$f"\)

    echo "\\033[1;35m══════════════════════════════════════════════════\\033[0m"
    echo "\\033[1;35m  QUEUE: file \\$CURRENT of \\$TOTAL — \\$filename\\033[0m"
    echo "\\033[1;35m══════════════════════════════════════════════════\\033[0m"
    echo ""

    /usr/bin/python3 "$SCRIPT_DIR/transcribe.py" "\\$f" 2>&1

    if [ \\$? -eq 0 ]; then
        SUCCEEDED=\\$\(\(SUCCEEDED + 1\)\)
    else
        FAILED=\\$\(\(FAILED + 1\)\)
        echo "\\033[1;31m  ERROR: \\$filename\\033[0m"
    fi
    echo ""
done < "\\$FILE_LIST"

echo "\\033[1;35m══════════════════════════════════════════════════\\033[0m"
echo "\\033[1;35m  QUEUE COMPLETE\\033[0m"
echo "\\033[1;35m  Total:     \\$TOTAL\\033[0m"
echo "\\033[1;32m  Success:   \\$SUCCEEDED\\033[0m"
if [ \\$FAILED -gt 0 ]; then
    echo "\\033[1;31m  Failed:    \\$FAILED\\033[0m"
fi
echo "\\033[1;35m══════════════════════════════════════════════════\\033[0m"
INNEREOF

chmod +x ""$RUNNER""
/bin/zsh ""$RUNNER"" 2>&1)
